verdict.rationale: Managing email templates as code is a fair question for an email marketing and transactional platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a templates API, HTML/MJML import, variable or merge-tag substitution, or any version-control workflow. The only nearby items are a generic 'Design better emails' marketing line and a community mention of a Code module inside the drag-and-drop builder, and neither establishes code-managed templates.
